'''2020 TMW Pods Matt Carulli DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Carulli]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Pods).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Matt Carulli]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open BHBM Carulli DS 2020 TMW.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Pods
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-texas-mini-worlds/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20201027000438/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-texas-mini-worlds/ Internet Archive]
